hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 2000 ms, a score_ruin_nodes that (a) rescales normalized removal savings by a capacity-slack factor raised to an iter_frac-scheduled exponent so that near-full routes (load/Q > 0.9) are progressively shielded while slack-rich routes stay destroyable early, (b) adds a sector-coherence term keyed on |cos(angle to depot)| and radial distance so ruin sets stay spatially contiguous on clustered geometries, and (c) injects a stagnation_ratio-driven randomized mid-tail component (rank exponent rising from ~0 to ~1.5 on stagnation) will lower the mean objective below the round-5 SBS of 15.8374, with the largest absolute reductions on tight-capacity, clustered-spatial, eccentric-depot and size-100 instances, since the existing rule's uniform load gating mis-sizes ruin scope when capacity slack is the binding constraint.

next_search_advice.direction: Capacity-slack-aware multi-scale ruin scope with cluster-coherent sector destruction and stagnation-triggered tail randomization, dedicated to tight-capacity / clustered / eccentric-depot / size-100 regimes.
